data_kind: Real England/Wales residential EPC certificates and assessor recommendation references

audit.identity_method: Valid 1–12 digit positive UPRN; unique full-address/postcode links attach missing UPRNs; otherwise exact full-address/postcode group. All UPRNs linked to ambiguous address or conflicting certificate excluded globally.
audit.sample_note: Whole held-out region is excluded from development. The final regional evaluation is a deterministic property sample, not a census of that region. Missing/unreliable identities are excluded, not assumed independent.

protocol.sample_rule: First 8 hex characters of property-group SHA256 modulo 2000 = 0
protocol.split_rule: Region priority, then any unresolved historical geography or chronology withheld, then latest lodgement >=2025, then SHA256 characters 9–16 modulo 10: 0–5 development, 6–7 validation, 8–9 property_holdout
protocol.identity: Valid 1–12 digit positive UPRN; unique full-address/postcode links attach missing UPRNs; otherwise exact full-address/postcode group. All UPRNs linked to ambiguous address or conflicting certificate excluded globally.
protocol.label: Only positive EPC recommendation-summary references, never negative labels or measured effects
protocol.flood_scope: No EPC-based flood hazard or physical flood recommendations. Energy-only constraint checks.
protocol.final_policy: Freeze before development-rule inspection. One final evaluation per output directory; no tuning on final partitions.

limitations: EPC recommendations are assessor/modelled positive references, not measured intervention outcomes. Missing recommendations are not negatives; false recommendation rate is not identifiable.
Declared compatibility and constraint checks are internal validation, not independent survey approval or true suitability labels. Permissions/listed status are unavailable.

Original construction intervals govern source scope and subgroup analysis. Where the app’s coarse age enum cannot represent an interval or unknown age, its compatibility code is not an observed age; original bounds and warnings are retained, and uncertain post-1999 scope must abstain.

EPC features and recommendations come from the same assessment; agreement is partly structural. Certificates can be old or expired and do not verify current property condition. The register is not a housing census.
EPC age/fabric may be assumed. Existing partial loft insulation is conservatively outside the app’s explicitly uninsulated-loft rule; top-up recommendations can disagree.
Bungalows have a published NEED group but no faithful existing app property-type representation; they and unsupported fuels/forms are excluded rather than mapped to detached houses.

Positive reference agreement covers loft, cavity-wall and solid-wall insulation only. Other selected measures have mathematical constraint checks, not independent external eligibility or effectiveness labels.
No bills, achieved retrofit effects, personal prediction intervals or measured flood damage reductions are validated. Published NEED effects remain external group scenarios.

Geography comes from native region/LA codes; the regional test is a deterministic property sample from a wholly development-excluded region. Historical boundary/identifier changes and imperfect address fallback can still cause residual grouping error.

Temporal holdout uses distinct properties with latest certificates from 2025 onwards. It is a contemporaneous record-snapshot shift test, not a prospective prediction or retrofit-effect stability experiment.
Optimisation uses declared 2000/10000/25000 GBP budget scenarios, no EPC-derived household budgets, and no inferred flood hazard. The independent enumeration shares benefit functions.
Descriptive results apply to the audited and identity-screened property sample, not a nationally weighted performance estimate. Identity exclusions can induce selection bias.

Local EPC splits are disjoint, but overlap with the publisher’s underlying NEED cohorts cannot be ruled out without linked treatment identities. The original product already had York context; this is an EPC-record holdout, not proof of a wholly unseen research geography.
All final outcome metrics were computed after rule sealing in one final run; development and final partitions are disjoint.

evidence_separation.epc: Real records: mapping, positive reference agreement, source-scope abstention.
evidence_separation.need: Published observational intervention-cohort effects; no individual ground truth.
evidence_separation.synthetic: Separate existing demo profiles; excluded from EPC results.
